## Default Permission

Every speech command: whether this computer can hear and record, whether the
person has let it, asking them, recording, and hearing a recording.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-available`
- `allow-authorization`
- `allow-request-authorization`
- `allow-transcribe`
- `allow-microphone`
- `allow-request-microphone`
- `allow-start-recording`
- `allow-stop-recording`
